A cheerful stretch ahead, some practical advice
The subject is hand-off notes
Travelers flying with pets should check their hand-off details before arriving at Aurelia Skyways.

Travel with animals works best when the paperwork is tidy and the carrier is ready. At the Companion Animal Travel Desk, staff give each pet steady attention and keep the process calm from start to finish. Please bring clean supplies, keep collars secure, and make sure your animal is comfortable before the hand-off. <<FACT F075>> <<FACT F057>>

If your pet needs extra support, tell the desk early so the team can review the plan in a calm stepwise way. Small updates, clear labels, and a steady pace help everything move along without stress. Phoebe and other traveling pets are handled with care, and the staff will help you settle the details with a practical, friendly approach.

Please stop by the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure for final check-in guidance.
